beats.text: One sunny morning, Adalyn, you found a glowing map in your backyard. Can you see the sparkly path leading into the woods? It’s time to go—her adventure begins now!
beats.speaker: parent

beats.text: Now Adalyn, can you say the word 'you'?
beats.speaker: coach

beats.text: The map showed a rainbow bridge and a talking frog who knew what to do. Her heart beat fast—was she ready to go? The wind whispered, 'You can do it!'
beats.speaker: parent

beats.text: Now say 'what'—what do you think she should do?
beats.speaker: coach

beats.text: The path split in two—one went over the rainbow, the other under the root tunnel. What should she do? Her toes wiggled with excitement.
beats.speaker: parent

beats.text: Say the word 'go'—can you help her decide to go?
beats.speaker: coach

beats.text: She tried the rainbow, but it slipped! Then she tried the roots, crawling through with a brave little hum. What a brave try! Her knees were dusty, but she didn’t quit.
beats.speaker: parent

beats.text: Say 'what' again—what should she try next?
beats.speaker: coach

beats.text: She saw a tiny key beneath a toadstool. Her fingers shook as she picked it up. What could it open? She wasn’t sure, but she kept going.
beats.speaker: parent

beats.text: Now say 'see'—can you see the treasure box ahead?
beats.speaker: coach

beats.text: You did it, Adalyn! You helped her go, you said the words, and you can see the glittering treasure! You, her, go, see, what—every word led the way!
beats.speaker: parent

choices.preview_text: Crawl through the curly root tunnel
